title: Governed MoonRey Cross-Domain Attribution Policy Engine
notes: IMPLEMENTED by extending packages/sunrey-chain/src/productive/policy-governance/attribution. Evolves Chunk 74 CrossCategoryAllocationRule and CapacityOutputAllocationRule into a versioned attribution policy. MoonReyPolicyRegistry remains the only policy registry. Attribution assigns shares only. It does not mint MoonRey, perform final valuation, or activate production. evaluateChunkRequirements returns mustStop: false. Do not create packages/attribution-policy, packages/moonrey-attribution, packages/productive-attribution, or packages/attribution-engine.
